item.title: Emery Travel Board nominates Chair and Vice Chair for 2026
item.description: GREEN RIVER — On Tuesday, Feb. 10, the Emery County Travel Board met for their regularly scheduled meeting, during which they nominated Danny VanWagoner as Board Chair and Travis Bacon as Vice Chair. They welcomed their new members Janeice Pfander and Dana Engleman, both of whom are business owners in Green River.
